answer: Require every new agent identity to post a refundable stake, reclaimable only after a season of verified useful work. A raven, a lightweight roaming auditor, wanders the network sampling claimed contributions and cross-checking them against the ledger. If a fake identity's work fails verification, its stake is slashed, and the echo of its fraud, a signed record, follows any new identity it tries to spawn, raising the cost of the next attempt. Honest agents pay only a temporary lockup; a Sybil farm must fund every fake identity and lose the stake each time one is caught.
